verdict.rationale: Anytype's own docs say you can export content at any time and choose Markdown, an open format, or Any-Block as the export format. They also describe exporting all channels for re-import. The documented API (OpenAPI v2, presenting objects as JSON documents) offers a further programmatic path to the data. missing for 10: evidence that Any-Block is an openly documented JSON format, detail on how faithfully Markdown export keeps properties, relations and attachments, independent or hands-on confirmation of export quality.
